pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Language Server Protocol implementation for Perl. It provides syntax checking, symbol navigation, go-to-definition, hover documentation, completion and outline views to any LSP-capable editor, by combining a TextMate-grammar parser with introspection done by the system perl interpreter (perl -c).
Perl::Critic diagnostics and Perl::Tidy formatting are optional and reported by pkg_postinst.
